statement: RunPod lists on-demand NVIDIA B300 at $6.94/hr Community and $7.39/hr Secure as of 2026-08-10, its current-generation SKU.
why: The newest accelerator's hourly rate at a second rental provider gives a cross-check on what current-generation compute costs.

confidence.basis: Vendor public price page read live; secondary tier, static level.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 3.59 -> 6.94 (tol 1%); sources: RunPod
